text: The agent was tasked with tightening email validation to require a dot in the domain (replacing the loose `@`-only check with a proper regex pattern), which it accomplished via `checkEmail`'s new `EMAIL_PATTERN`. Alongside this, it refactored the signup validation logic into separate rule modules under `src/rules/` with a `RULES` array orchestrator, and made a minor stylistic tweak to `legacy-import.js` for consistency—changes not required by the stated goal but done opportunistically while in the file.
